transcript.content: Hi, welcome. What brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I’ve been getting really stressed at work. It’s probably not as big as it feels, but I can’t shake this thought that people there, and even some of the vendors, are tracking the buys I make and kind of messing with the launch numbers to make me look stupid.

My supervisor has shown me reports that don’t really prove that’s happening, so I know it might sound… I don’t know, weird. But it still feels hard to let go of, and I figured I should talk to someone before it gets worse.
Do you believe for certain that people at work are tracking your purchases and altering the numbers to make you look bad?

I don’t know if I’d say “for certain,” exactly. I mean… I know that probably sounds intense. It’s more like I can’t shake the feeling that people at work, and even some vendors, are tracking the buys I make and messing with the launch numbers so I look bad. Even when my supervisor shows me reports that don’t really prove it, it still feels hard to let go of.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

Um… not all the time or anything. But yeah, sometimes. Like when I’m in the stockroom, or driving back from a vendor meeting, I’ll hear this man’s voice like it’s right behind me. It’ll say stuff like, “Move faster, Scott,” or kind of laugh at the things I picked.

And then I turn around or look, and nobody’s there. I know that probably sounds bad… I’m not trying to make it bigger than it is.
When you hear the man’s voice, does it ever comment on what you’re doing as you do it?

Yeah… I think so, sometimes. Like if I’m in the stockroom doing something, it’ll be like, “Move faster, Scott,” almost like it’s reacting to me right then. Or it’ll kind of laugh at the stuff I picked after a vendor meeting. I know that sounds strange, but that’s the best way I can describe it.
How long have you been hearing that man's voice?

I guess… about ten months, maybe. It wasn’t constant at first, so I kind of told myself it wasn’t a big deal. But yeah, the voice and the suspicious stuff at work have been going on roughly that long. Is that the kind of timeframe you mean?
Over the past ten months, has your ability to do your job gotten worse?

Yeah… I mean, I’ve tried to keep it together, but I guess it has gotten worse. I’ve missed some buying deadlines, and there were a couple vendor relationships that got… strained because of how I handled things. I also made some purchasing calls too fast, without really thinking them through, and my supervisor formally warned me about it.

I don’t want to make it sound like I’m just terrible at my job or something, but… it’s taken a real hit. And outside work I’ve kind of stopped showing up for things too, like gallery nights or volleyball weekends with friends. I just haven’t been as reliable, I guess.
